description: A completed FAILURE listed before a row of the same name still in flight — the case the old rule got right for the wrong reason. 'A completed row beats an in-flight one' is the correct rule, and it must hold when the completed row is the bad news too: a re-run that is still running does not retract the failure that is already recorded, and reporting `running` here is how a wait outlives the fact that started it.
